measurement_origin: Values reported in the active manuscript tables; not re-evaluated for the project page.

mnist_ffhq.scope: Complete eight-row MNIST and FFHQ comparison from the active manuscript table.
mnist_ffhq.release_scope: MNIST and FFHQ implementation included; original image checkpoints and complete historical run provenance are not included.

protocol.mnist: Class-conditional generation in a learned 16-dimensional autoencoder latent space. EMD is average per-class squared 2-Wasserstein distance between test and generated latents. Accuracy uses a classifier trained on the MNIST training split.
protocol.ffhq: Six-class generation in frozen 512-dimensional ALAE latent space. Latent EMD and FID are reported; FID compares generated and real latents decoded by the same frozen ALAE decoder at 1024 x 1024, not raw-image-reference FID.

imagenet.scope: DFM rows only from the active ImageNet 256 x 256 comparison.
imagenet.release_scope: Paper result; ImageNet implementation and checkpoints are outside this code release.
imagenet.protocol: ImageNet-1k 256 x 256 synthesis using a pretrained VAE tokenizer with 32 x 32 x 4 latents and a latent-MAE feature-space DFM objective. FID and IS are evaluated on 50,000 randomly generated images, following the Drift Model protocol.

robotics.scope: Two representative DFM Policy task-setting rows; not the complete robotics table.
robotics.release_scope: Paper result; robotics implementation and checkpoints are outside this code release.
robotics.protocol: The core policy is replaced with DFM under the Diffusion Policy and Drift Policy experimental setting. DFM loss uses raw control representations. Reported success rates average the last 10 checkpoints.
